newsitem.title: USA: Seven Cajun Co-ops Sign with SWEPCO.
newsitem.headline: Seven Cajun Co-ops Sign with SWEPCO.

text.p: Seven electric distribution cooperatives in Louisiana have signed exclusive term sheets supporting Southwestern Electric Power Co's plan in the bankruptcy of Cajun Electric Power Cooperative Inc, Southwestern said.
The Central and South West Corp subsidiary said an eighth cooperative also has voted to support its plan.

The term sheets include the major provisions of the 25-year power supply agreements under which Southwestern would provide electricity to the cooperatives if the plan proposed by the utility, Entergy Corp and the Cajun Members Committee is confirmed by the bankruptcy court.

In signing the term sheets, the cooperatives have agreed to support the Southwestern plan exclusively throughout the confirmation process and, if it is successful, to sign power supply agreements that are now being finalized.

Southwestern said it has had contact with several of Cajun's other four member cooperatives, three of which have signed memoranda of understanding to support the plan submitted jointly by Northern States Power Co, Zeigler Coal Holding Co and Southern Co.
Those agreements allow the co-ops to talk to other bidders, the utility noted, adding it will continue negotiations with any other co-ops that are interested.
Confirmation hearings reconvene in federal bankruptcy court in Opelousas, La., April 21-24 and are scheduled to continue during May and June.
